svg.title: SNS fanout: publish once, reach several subscribers
svg.desc: A publisher sends one event to an Amazon SNS Standard topic. The topic fans out copies to matching subscriptions: an SQS queue, Lambda function, Data Firehose stream, HTTP or HTTPS endpoint, and email address. Optional policies filter messages per subscription.
svg.text: SNS fanout: publish once, reach several subscribers
Read left to right. Each branch is a separate subscription.
Optional filter policies decide which messages each subscription receives.
